intro: Nee Premaye Na Jeevithamunu is the latest Telugu Christian song written, music composed and produced by Dr. Victor Rampogu, sung by Sravani Leena Vakapalli. This song was released on July 3, 2026, through Victor Rampogu Channel YouTube Channel.
